mapper.sql: select c.config_id, c.config_code, c.country, c.degree, c.version, c.file_status, c.publish_status, cast(c.warnings as text) as warnings, c.activated_by, c.activated_time, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from abr_engine_config c

select c.config_id, c.config_code, c.country, c.degree, c.version, c.file_status, c.publish_status, cast(c.config as text) as config, cast(c.warnings as text) as warnings, c.activated_by, c.activated_time, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from abr_engine_config c
mapper.select: where c.degree = #{degree} and c.publish_status = 'active' and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.country
where c.country = #{country} and c.degree = #{degree} and c.publish_status = 'active' and c.del_flag = '0'
where c.config_code = #{configCode} and c.version = #{version} and c.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into abr_engine_config (config_code, country, degree, version, file_status, publish_status, config, warnings, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{configCode}, #{country}, #{degree}, #{version}, coalesce(#{fileStatus}, 'draft'), 'draft', cast(#{config} as jsonb), cast(#{warnings} as jsonb), '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_engine_config set publish_status = 'retired', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where country = #{country} and degree = #{degree} and publish_status = 'active' and del_flag = '0'

update abr_engine_config set publish_status = 'active', activated_by = #{updateBy}, activated_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where config_id = #{configId} and publish_status in ('draft', 'retired') and file_status = 'confirmed' and del_flag = '0'
